text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... When I get back to my room, I'll 
display it right next to my historical 
records.
choice_data_list:
If we're going to display them, might as 
well aim for the complete set.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What?! I'd certainly be delighted if that 
were possible, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No. Considering the claw's strength and 
speed, as well as the structure and 
balance of the Paka Puchi plush... it 
might not be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Above all, if Trainer says so, then surely 
it can be done...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let us construct it: the ultimate method 
for guaranteed victory at the crane 
game...!
